title: Cocoa Frozen Yoghurt
changes_from_base: Low-fat yoghurt is drained only briefly and set with a little gelatine in hot milk whisked with Dutch-process cocoa.
summary: A rich, velvety chocolate frozen yoghurt made with Dutch-process cocoa powder. Deep in flavour and satisfyingly smooth.

ingredients.note: 60 ml to soak the gelatine, 355 ml heated

steps.title: Drain
steps.text: Set a fine sieve over a jug, tip in the 490 g yoghurt and leave it in the fridge for 1-2 h, until 120 ml of liquid has dripped through; pour that liquid away.

steps.title: Bloom
steps.text: Scatter the 2 tsp gelatine over 60 ml cold milk in a small bowl and leave it 10 min, stirring every so often.

steps.title: Warm
steps.text: Heat 355 ml milk with 200 g caster sugar and 6 tbsp Dutch-process cocoa powder, stirring until dissolved.

steps.title: Combine
steps.text: Off the heat, whisk in the bloomed gelatine until dissolved. Cool to room temperature.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Add 1 tsp vanilla to the drained yoghurt and stir in the cooled cocoa milk until evenly brown.

steps.title: Churn
steps.text: Churn until frozen and scoopable, then eat it soft straight away or pack it into a sealed container and freeze for up to 2 days.

tips: Use Dutch-process cocoa for the deepest, smoothest chocolate flavour.
Whisk the cocoa powder into the heated milk thoroughly to prevent lumps.
Eat within 2 days for the creamiest texture; prolonged freezing makes it icy.
storage: Store in a sealed freezer container for up to 2 days.
